verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the Croisette in Cannes, with contemporary design, sea views and a seafront setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to a luxury stay on the Croisette at a Cannes hotel with contemporary design, sea views, and a prime seafront setting.

verified_facts.text: Palais Stéphanie Beach is the hotel's partner beach, across La Croisette from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bask in luxury at our hotel on La Croisette, opposite its partner beach.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's partner beach is Palais Stéphanie Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: surrounded by waterfront walks, luxury shopping, renowned restaurants, and Palais Stéphanie Beach, the hotel’s partner beach.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a signature cinema theme with leather-clad walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a signature cinema theme and leather-clad walls, the hotel honors its history as the former Palais des Festivals.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Mediterranean, the gardens or the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking views of the Mediterranean, gardens, or the city.

verified_facts.text: Sea-view rooms look out to the coastline and the Lérins Islands, from the room or a balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the coastline, the sea breeze and the picturesque Lérins Islands from the comfort of your room or balcony.

verified_facts.text: Sea-view luxury suites have panoramic views of the Mediterranean and the Croisette through expansive windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: our luxury suites with sea view offer stunning panoramic views of the Mediterranean and the iconic Croisette, with expansive windows that fill the room with light.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are made entirely of marble and wood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entirely made of marble and wood, our stylish bathrooms offer a chic and sober design as well as noble beauty products.

verified_facts.text: Beds are plush pillowtop beds with deluxe linens.
verified_facts.excerpt: A restful night's sleep is always on the cards with plush pillowtop beds and deluxe linens.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop swimming pool and is a 5-minute walk from the Palais des Festivals.
verified_facts.excerpt: This luxury Cannes hotel with a rooftop swimming pool is a 5-minute walk from the Palais des

verified_facts.text: Le Panorama Rooftop is seasonal, with panoramic views over the Bay of Cannes, the Lérins Islands and the Estérel mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy panoramic views over the Bay of Cannes, the Lérins Islands and Estérel mountains at the seasonal Panorama Rooftop

verified_facts.text: Scalini serves traditional Italian cuisine in a modern restaurant with an open kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy traditional Italian cuisine and authentic Cannes dining in a modern restaurant with an open kitchen, where chefs prepare generous dishes from fine ingredients.

verified_facts.text: The Palais Stéphanie Beach restaurant serves an international menu with Japanese specialities and views of the Lérins Islands and Estérel mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor an international menu with signature Japanese specialities and sea views of the Lérins Islands and Estérel mountains at Palais Stéphanie Beach, our partner beach.

verified_facts.text: Some S Bar cocktails use herbs grown on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the JW Garden, selected creations feature herbs grown on site for a memorable bar experience.

verified_facts.text: The Sunset Terrace is a terrace bar on the Croisette for champagne and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique Cannes terrace bar in the Croisette is the place to enjoy champagne and cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Golden Key concierges handle local recommendations, restaurant reservations and customized activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experts in personalized service, they are here to meet all your needs, whether it's local recommendations, reservations at exclusive restaurants, or customized activities.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has Golden Key concierges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience exceptional service with our Golden Key concierges

verified_facts.text: Families are welcome, with spacious connecting rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Families are welcome, with spacious connecting rooms for a comfortable and memorable stay.

verified_facts.text: For the summer fireworks festival, the hotel offers dinner on its panoramic rooftop or a feet-in-the-sand dinner on its partner private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: a refined dinner under the stars on our panoramic rooftop, offering sweeping views of the bay, or a feet-in-the-sand dinner on our partner private beach

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at JW Marriott Cannes do not have a fridge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers pet-friendly stays.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers luxury rooms, event spaces, and pet-friendly stays.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an auditorium and 14 conference rooms for events.
verified_facts.excerpt: Host your event in our auditorium, the only one in the Provence Alpes-Côte d’Azur region, or in one of our 14 conference rooms

verified_facts.text: Bicycle rental is available for exploring.
verified_facts.excerpt: with bicycle rental available
